title: config/release.json
description: The packages, manifests and Go modules that a release tag covers, read by scripts/kit/release.mts.

repositoryUrl.description: The URL of the repository; the notes of a release that is too long link CHANGELOG.md below it.

changelog.description: The change log whose section `## X.Y.Z` is the notes of the release.

changelogTranslations.description: Further change logs that must hold the section `## X.Y.Z`.

packages.description: The packages that a tag vX.Y.Z releases as one archive each, or one per platform and PHP minor for a per-platform package, under the name its packer gives (a wheel its PEP 427 name) and with the GitHub label <vendor>-<product>-<runtime>-<version>[-php<X.Y>][-<platform>], the vendor the owner of repositoryUrl (P39, K980, K1189).

platforms.description: The platforms that a per-platform package (wheel-abi3, php-ext, npm-native, go-static) is built for, each on a runner of its own (K1189).

php.description: The PHP minors X.Y that a php-ext package is built for, since the extension ABI differs for each minor (K1189).

directory.description: The directory of the package below the root, or . for a package at the root of the repository (kit itself).

product.description: The product of the package, the part of the asset label after the vendor: x for @acme/x and acme/x-php-ext (K980).

runtime.description: The runtime of the package, one of the six runtimes, the part of the asset label after the product (K980).

generated.description: Artifacts that are generated from the package files of the tagged commit and included in its archive; never written into the checkout. A make entry runs its target (the repository's own make target) in the checkout, after the pack refuses a checkout that differs from the tagged commit, holds a changed or untracked path, or links a dependency from outside it; it packs its declared outputs (K929, K930, K939), for a composer or wheel package; npm builds its output in the prepack script of its package.json, so an npm package refuses a make entry.

manifests.description: Each manifest whose version a tag vX.Y.Z sets, with how the tag releases it: archive, version or git-tag.

notReleased.description: Each tracked manifest that no tag releases, with the reason.

goModules.description: Each Go module by its directory (`.` for the repository root) with its module path; release-tag creates the tag <directory>/vX.Y.Z of each module below the root with vX.Y.Z (K911).

packageFiles.description: The names of the package files that release coverage classifies, such as package.json, composer.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod and VERSION; a manifest key is one of them other than go.mod (K1114). kit sets none.

writtenFiles.description: Globs of the package files that tools write into the checkout and no tag releases, such as config/phpunit/composer.json and .mise/locks/** (K167, K1114). Read by picomatch with dot: true.

fixtures.description: Globs of the tracked fixtures of the tests, whose manifests and locks belong to the tests: the checks and release coverage leave them out (K1114). Read by picomatch with dot: true.

contracts.description: The contracts of the repository (K1209). Before it builds an archive, the release runs the check command of the contract tool of the repository for each file, followed by the file and --release, in the checkout of the commit; a status other than 0 stops the release.

check.description: The command of the contract tool as the repository runs its check, a program path relative to the checkout or a name of PATH, and its leading arguments.

files.description: The contract files, relative to the root of the repository.

annotatedTags.description: The repository's own rule that an existing release tag is annotated (K1084); without it a tag at the commit passes whatever its kind.
